space.name: Government-Wide Administration Space
space.description: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.

universe.description: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
includes: central personnel, budget, procurement, and digital administration

meta.description: Seven comparative representation systems for the space of government-wide administrative systems: submodel, structural-configuration, system-properties, function-allocation, decision-rights, and two WWBI indicator frames.

systems.name: submodel
systems.title: Submodel Characterisation Frame
systems.description: The note's own characterisation system: an orthogonal decomposition of a well-functioning government-wide administration into 23 submodels, each carrying the dimensions that locate a system within its domain.
systems.frame_basis: Functional submodel decomposition, optimised for comprehensive coverage and orthogonality.
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Full submodel characterization: every administrative submodel contributes characteristic elements to one profile.

groups.name: Coordination Model

groups.name: Institutional Model

groups.name: Authority Model

groups.name: Integration Model

groups.name: Standardization Model

groups.name: Administrative Control Model

groups.name: Service-Provision Model

groups.name: Regulatory Model

groups.name: Accountability Model

characteristic_element_set.name: Coordination structure
characteristic_element_set.description: Organizational arrangement through which administrative action is coordinated across government.

characteristic_element_set.name: Coordination authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Authority responsible for initiating, directing, and maintaining cross-government coordination.

characteristic_element_set.name: Coordination intensity
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which participating organizations coordinate their administrative activities.

characteristic_element_set.name: Conflict resolution
characteristic_element_set.description: Mechanisms used to resolve disagreements between administrative organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Participation requirements
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which administrative organizations are required to participate in coordination arrangements.

characteristic_element_set.name: Functional allocation
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of government-wide administrative functions among central authorities and participating organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Functional concentration
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree to which responsibility for a function is concentrated in a single organization or distributed across several organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Functional specialization
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which administrative organizations specialize in particular government-wide functions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Functional autonomy
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree of discretion organizations have over the execution of their assigned administrative functions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Functional overlap
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which administrative responsibilities overlap between institutions or organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Functional coverage
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which the administrative system assigns responsibility for the relevant government-wide functions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Career and employment system
characteristic_element_set.description: General arrangement through which public personnel enter, remain in, and progress through government employment.

characteristic_element_set.name: Recruitment system
characteristic_element_set.description: Principal arrangements for recruiting personnel into administrative positions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Selection authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Organizational level responsible for selecting personnel.

characteristic_element_set.name: Employment security
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree and basis of employment protection for public personnel.

characteristic_element_set.name: Career progression
characteristic_element_set.description: Principal mechanism through which personnel advance to higher positions or grades.

characteristic_element_set.name: Personnel mobility
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which personnel can move between government organizations and occupational groups.

characteristic_element_set.name: Remuneration system
characteristic_element_set.description: How salaries and related compensation are determined across government.

characteristic_element_set.name: Senior executive system
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements governing the recruitment, appointment, development, and management of senior administrators.

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional configuration
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of government-wide administrative responsibilities among institutions and administrative bodies.

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional mandate
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree to which the responsibilities and jurisdiction of each institution are formally defined.

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional autonomy
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree of organizational independence enjoyed by administrative institutions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional specialization
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which institutions have distinct functional mandates.

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional hierarchy
characteristic_element_set.description: Formal hierarchical relationships among institutions responsible for government-wide administration.

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional stability
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree of continuity in the system's institutional configuration.

characteristic_element_set.name: Decision-making authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of formal authority to make administrative decisions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Delegation arrangements
characteristic_element_set.description: Rules and practices governing the transfer of decision-making authority to subordinate or participating organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Reserved powers
characteristic_element_set.description: Decisions retained exclusively by central or designated authorities.

characteristic_element_set.name: Rulemaking authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of authority to establish administrative rules and binding standards.

characteristic_element_set.name: Enforcement authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of authority to enforce government-wide administrative requirements.

characteristic_element_set.name: Discretion
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree of freedom organizations have when applying common administrative requirements.

characteristic_element_set.name: Review and appeal rights
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for reviewing administrative decisions and challenging their application.

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional integration
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which administrative institutions operate through connected governance and organizational arrangements.

characteristic_element_set.name: Procedural integration
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which administrative procedures and workflows are coordinated across organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Information integration
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which administrative information is shared and usable across government organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Technical interoperability
characteristic_element_set.description: Ability of administrative information systems to exchange and process information.

characteristic_element_set.name: Semantic interoperability
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which organizations use compatible definitions, classifications, and meanings for shared information.

characteristic_element_set.name: Integration governance
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for setting priorities, standards, and responsibilities for system-wide integration.

characteristic_element_set.name: Administrative standardization
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which common administrative rules, procedures, classifications, and standards apply across government.

characteristic_element_set.name: Standardization scope
characteristic_element_set.description: Range of organizations, functions, and processes covered by common standards.

characteristic_element_set.name: Standard-setting authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Authority responsible for establishing common administrative standards.

characteristic_element_set.name: Binding force
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree to which common standards are legally or administratively mandatory.

characteristic_element_set.name: Permitted variation
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which organizations may deviate from common administrative standards.

characteristic_element_set.name: Exception management
characteristic_element_set.description: Procedures for requesting, authorizing, documenting, and reviewing exceptions to common standards.

characteristic_element_set.name: Control mechanisms
characteristic_element_set.description: Principal mechanisms through which authorities influence and monitor administrative organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Ex ante control
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which decisions and transactions require approval or verification before execution.

characteristic_element_set.name: Ex post control
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which completed decisions and activities are reviewed for compliance and performance.

characteristic_element_set.name: Control locus

characteristic_element_set.name: Corrective authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Authority to require corrective action when administrative deficiencies are identified.

characteristic_element_set.name: Sanctioning capacity
characteristic_element_set.description: Ability to impose consequences for noncompliance or administrative misconduct.

characteristic_element_set.name: Risk orientation
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which control activities are prioritized according to assessed risks.

characteristic_element_set.name: Shared-service provision
characteristic_element_set.description: Organizational arrangement through which common administrative services are delivered.

characteristic_element_set.name: Service ownership
characteristic_element_set.description: Institution responsible for defining service requirements and overseeing service delivery.

characteristic_element_set.name: Service delivery location
characteristic_element_set.description: Where common administrative services are operationally performed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Service coverage
characteristic_element_set.description: Range of organizations eligible or required to use shared administrative services.

characteristic_element_set.name: Service financing
characteristic_element_set.description: How shared administrative services are financed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Service-level governance
characteristic_element_set.description: How service quality, responsibilities, costs, and delivery expectations are agreed and monitored.

characteristic_element_set.name: Outsourcing arrangements

characteristic_element_set.name: Rulemaking and regulation

characteristic_element_set.description: Range of administrative functions and organizations governed by common regulatory arrangements.

characteristic_element_set.description: Relationship between general administrative rules and function-specific or organization-specific requirements.

characteristic_element_set.name: Regulatory coherence

characteristic_element_set.name: Rule revision

characteristic_element_set.name: Regulatory consultation

characteristic_element_set.name: Accountability structure
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangement of relationships through which administrative organizations account for decisions, compliance, and results.

characteristic_element_set.name: Accountability direction

value_set: Downward to service users or the public

characteristic_element_set.name: Reporting obligations

characteristic_element_set.name: Oversight independence

characteristic_element_set.name: Transparency obligations

characteristic_element_set.name: Digital identity and access

characteristic_element_set.name: Cybersecurity governance

characteristic_element_set.name: Legacy-system dependence

characteristic_element_set.name: Resource distribution

characteristic_element_set.name: Budgetary authority

characteristic_element_set.name: Resource flexibility

characteristic_element_set.name: Implementation incentives

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional adaptability
characteristic_element_set.description: Ability of the administrative system to respond to changing requirements and circumstances.

characteristic_element_set.name: Reform initiation

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional memory

characteristic_element_set.name: Performance management arrangements
characteristic_element_set.description: Organization of the processes through which administrative performance is defined, measured, reviewed, and used.

characteristic_element_set.name: Indicator standardization
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which common definitions and indicators are used across administrative organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Target setting

characteristic_element_set.name: Performance reporting
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for reporting administrative results across government.

characteristic_element_set.name: Evaluation independence

characteristic_element_set.name: Performance consequences

characteristic_element_set.name: Benchmarking

characteristic_element_set.name: Evaluation and learning cycle
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which performance evidence leads to review, corrective action, and subsequent reassessment.

characteristic_element_set.name: Strategic steering authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Authority responsible for setting the overall direction of government-wide administration.

characteristic_element_set.name: Leadership configuration

characteristic_element_set.name: Priority alignment

characteristic_element_set.description: Formal forums through which system-wide administrative decisions are discussed and made.

characteristic_element_set.name: Strategic dispute resolution
characteristic_element_set.description: Mechanisms for resolving competing priorities among administrative institutions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Steering accountability
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for holding system-wide leaders and steering bodies accountable for their direction and decisions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Planning horizon

characteristic_element_set.name: Administrative strategy
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which government-wide administration is guided by an explicit strategic framework.

characteristic_element_set.name: Priority setting

characteristic_element_set.name: Planning integration

characteristic_element_set.name: Strategic review

characteristic_element_set.name: Process architecture
characteristic_element_set.description: How government-wide administrative workflows and procedures are structured.

characteristic_element_set.name: Process ownership

characteristic_element_set.name: Workflow integration
characteristic_element_set.description: Degree to which processes connect activities across organizational boundaries.

characteristic_element_set.name: Process standardization
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which common process designs and procedures are used across organizations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Process automation
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which administrative processes are automated through digital systems.

characteristic_element_set.name: Process performance
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which process efficiency, timeliness, cost, and error rates are systematically measured.

characteristic_element_set.name: Process redesign
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for simplifying, reengineering, and improving administrative workflows.

characteristic_element_set.name: Ethics framework
characteristic_element_set.description: Existence and scope of common ethical principles and conduct requirements for public administration.

characteristic_element_set.name: Conflict-of-interest management
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for identifying, disclosing, preventing, and managing conflicts of interest.

characteristic_element_set.name: Anti-corruption coordination
characteristic_element_set.description: Organization of responsibilities for preventing and addressing corruption across government.

characteristic_element_set.name: Whistleblowing protection

characteristic_element_set.name: Integrity oversight
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for monitoring compliance with ethics and integrity requirements.

characteristic_element_set.name: Disciplinary arrangements
characteristic_element_set.description: How misconduct is investigated, adjudicated, and sanctioned across government.

characteristic_element_set.name: Integrity risk management
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which corruption and ethical risks are systematically identified and mitigated.

characteristic_element_set.name: Territorial coverage

characteristic_element_set.description: Degree of discretion exercised by subnational authorities over administrative arrangements.

characteristic_element_set.name: Capacity equalization
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for addressing differences in administrative capability across territorial governments.

characteristic_element_set.name: Intergovernmental dispute resolution
characteristic_element_set.description: Mechanisms for resolving administrative disputes between territorial levels of government.

characteristic_element_set.name: Knowledge management
characteristic_element_set.description: Arrangements for documenting, organizing, and making administrative knowledge available across government.

characteristic_element_set.name: Institutional memory
characteristic_element_set.description: Extent to which administrative records, precedents, decisions, and lessons survive personnel turnover and institutional change.

characteristic_element_set.name: Knowledge sharing

characteristic_element_set.name: Lessons-learned processes

characteristic_element_set.name: Professional learning networks

characteristic_element_set.name: Evidence use

characteristic_element_set.name: Knowledge transfer

systems.name: structural-configuration
systems.title: Structural Configuration Frame
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by the shape of its organization: how differentiated, how layered, how formalized, and how autonomous its units are.
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare structural configuration: how the administration is shaped.

characteristic_element_set.name: Centralization of authority

characteristic_element_set.name: Professionalization

characteristic_element_set.name: Unit autonomy

systems.name: function-allocation
systems.title: Function-Allocation Frame
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by where each core administrative function is performed along the center-agency axis.
systems.frame_basis: Distribution of the core administrative functions across performers.
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare how administrative functions are allocated across units.

groups.name: Function areas
groups.description: Allocation of core administrative functions.

characteristic_element_set.name: Budgeting function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where budget formulation, allocation, and control are performed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Accounting function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where accounting and financial reporting are performed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Human resource function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where public-employment and workforce management are performed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Procurement function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where public procurement and asset management are performed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Records and information function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where records management and information exchange are performed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Digital and information function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where common information systems and digital platforms are operated.

characteristic_element_set.name: Legal and regulatory function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where administrative-rule drafting and interpretation are performed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Audit and inspection function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where auditing, inspecting, and review are performed.

characteristic_element_set.name: Performance-evaluation function
characteristic_element_set.description: Where administrative performance is defined, measured, and used.

systems.name: decision-rights
systems.title: Authority and Decision-Rights Frame
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by who holds authority over each class of administrative decision.
systems.frame_basis: Distribution of formal decision rights across the administrative system.
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare where administrative decision rights sit.

groups.name: Decision domains
groups.description: Locus of authority per decision domain.

characteristic_element_set.name: Agenda-setting authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Who sets the government-wide administrative agenda.

characteristic_element_set.name: Rulemaking authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Who establishes administrative rules and binding standards.

characteristic_element_set.name: Resource-allocation authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Who allocates administrative budgets and resources.

characteristic_element_set.name: Staffing authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Who selects and appoints administrative personnel.

characteristic_element_set.name: Execution authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Who implements administrative policies and requirements.

characteristic_element_set.name: Oversight authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Who reviews compliance and performance.

characteristic_element_set.name: Sanctioning authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Who imposes consequences for noncompliance.

characteristic_element_set.name: Review and appeal authority
characteristic_element_set.description: Who hears challenges to administrative decisions.

systems.name: wwbi-employment-profile
systems.title: Public Employment Profile (WWBI)
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by the demographics of its public workforce, using the indicator families of the World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators.
systems.frame_basis: World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators (WWBI) - public employment demographics (commercial indicator framework: public sector footprint and workforce composition).
systems.provenance: World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators (WWBI), 302 indicators, 202 economies
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare public-employment profiles using World Bank WWBI indicators.

groups.name: Workforce composition
groups.description: Composition of the public-sector workforce.

characteristic_element_set.name: Public-employment share
characteristic_element_set.description: Public sector share of total employment.

characteristic_element_set.name: Public-employment size
characteristic_element_set.description: Absolute size of the public workforce.

characteristic_element_set.name: Female representation
characteristic_element_set.description: Share of women in public employment.

characteristic_element_set.name: Female-male employment ratio
characteristic_element_set.description: Balance of women to men in public employment.

characteristic_element_set.name: Age structure
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of public employees across age groups.

characteristic_element_set.name: Education composition
characteristic_element_set.description: Educational attainment profile of public employees.

characteristic_element_set.name: Occupational composition
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of public employees across occupations.

characteristic_element_set.name: Industry composition
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of public employees across sectors.

characteristic_element_set.name: Income-quintile composition
characteristic_element_set.description: Distribution of public employees across household income quintiles.

characteristic_element_set.name: Formality
characteristic_element_set.description: Share of public employment that is formal.

characteristic_element_set.name: Spatial distribution
characteristic_element_set.description: Urban-rural distribution of public employees.

systems.name: wwbi-compensation-profile
systems.title: Public Compensation Profile (WWBI)
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by how its public workforce is paid, using the indicator families of the World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators.
systems.frame_basis: World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators (WWBI) - wage premiums, pay compression, gender pay gaps, and the public sector wage bill (commercial indicator framework: compensation and fiscal footprint).
systems.provenance: World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators (WWBI), 302 indicators, 202 economies
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare public-compensation profiles using World Bank WWBI indicators.

groups.name: Compensation structure
groups.description: Compensation profile of the public workforce.

characteristic_element_set.name: Public-private wage premium
characteristic_element_set.description: Competitiveness of public versus private sector wages.

characteristic_element_set.name: Pay compression ratio
characteristic_element_set.description: Ratio of top to bottom pay within the public sector.

characteristic_element_set.name: Education wage differential
characteristic_element_set.description: Public pay differential by education level.

characteristic_element_set.name: Occupation wage differential
characteristic_element_set.description: Public pay differential by occupation.

characteristic_element_set.name: Gender pay gap
characteristic_element_set.description: Public-sector pay gap between women and men.

characteristic_element_set.name: Income-quintile wage differential
characteristic_element_set.description: Pay differential across household income quintiles within the public sector.

characteristic_element_set.name: Wage-bill size
characteristic_element_set.description: Public sector wage bill relative to GDP or expenditure.

characteristic_element_set.name: Wage-bill affordability
characteristic_element_set.description: Fiscal affordability of the public wage bill.
